entry.destination: Project-relative regular file path with no absolute or traversal segments.
entry.sha256: Lowercase SHA-256 of the source bytes.
entry.mergeKind: managed-file for a protected whole file; managed-block for bounded root loaders; seed-file for a record that becomes user-owned after safe creation.

installedState.publicDependency: Pinned public source identity for paid installations; null for free installations.
installedState.managedPaths: Per-destination installed hash, template hash, merge kind, and ownership needed for three-way upgrade.
installedState.receiptIds: Transaction receipt identifiers, without home paths or secrets.

receipt.manifestIdentity: Manifest version and content hash used by the transaction.
receipt.writes: Only paths and preimage/postimage hashes touched by this transaction.
receipt.rollback: Receipt-scoped undo information for this transaction only.
